text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking the top spot in the venue's overall 
rankings is Sonon Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although <chrname> couldn't manage to defeat her, 
she secured a spot in the finals. The two 
are now viewed by the public as the top 
contenders to win it all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Firing up their fighting spirit toward the 
championship tournament, they forge ahead!
